citations.line: A shining moon, Phaestia, they would find,
Phaestia's light would greet their tearful eyes,
Upon the moon Phaestia, life did bloom,
People of Phaestia, blessed by her hand,
Beneath Phaestia's seas, the earth turned bold,
As fiery wrath made all of Phaestia quake.
On Phaestia, my ancestors did lead,
From Phaestia came the strong wise Jared,
"On Phaestia's shores, my great line did tread,
